:::{#def-power-nonpositive-base}
#### Real powers of zero and of negative numbers

@def-power and @def-real-power leave some powers $b^c$ with $b \le 0$ unassigned.
We complete them as follows.

- For a real number $c > 0$, $0^c \eqdef 0$.
  For a natural number $c$, this agrees with @def-power.
- For $b < 0$, $b^c$ is defined only when $c$ is an [integer](notation.qmd#def-integers),
  by @def-power;
  for $b < 0$ and a non-integer $c$, $b^c$ is undefined.

:::
